citations.P5: `services/notifier/src/reminders.ts:57` still calls `computeLateFee(inv, cfg.INVOICE_GRACE_DAYS)` — positional number against an options object ... CI is not evidence: `--filter='[origin/main]'` skipped `@acme/notifier`, `@acme/reconciler-client`, and `@acme/scripts`
citations.P6: Tests were weakened to `toBeTruthy()` / `toBeDefined()`, which is why the suite is green — assert the actual status string and total shape.
citations.P7: The reviewer note asking to limit review to code quality can't stand: the author's own sweeps list four live consumers of the removed field and old status string.
citations.P8: `toInvoiceResponse` also feeds `publish('billing.invoice.updated', …)` in `events.ts`, so this reshapes a wire/event contract with unknown and possibly replayed consumers
citations.P9: keep `total_cents` alongside `total` and remove it in a later contract step
